name: MCB 2610
title: Fundamentals of Microbiology
description: Biology of microorganisms, especially bacteria. Cellular structure, physiology, genetics, and interactions with higher forms of life. Laboratory familiarizes students with methodology of microbiology and aseptic techniques.
requirement_description: CHEM 2241 or 2443, which may be taken concurrently. Recommended preparation: BIOL 1107. May not be taken out of sequence after passing MCB 3246, 3617, 3633, 3635, 3636, 3637, 3640, or 4624. Repeat restrictions apply; see advising.uconn.edu/repeat-policy for information.
